OpenJAUS HTML JAUS Reference

Here you will find documentation on the services and messages implemented as part of the OpenJAUS Software Development Kit (SDK).The OpenJAUS SDK provides a complete JAUS solution for software developers and provides a reliable, scalable solution to developing and maintaining the JAUS Standard.The JAUS Standards are published by the AS-4 Unmanned Systems Committee of SAE International and can be obtained here.The documentation here-in was created from OpenJAUS Service Set Definition files developed from the JAUS Service Interface Definition Language (JSIDL).
